QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has an equipment box to give you for reaching Lv. 70 as Luminous.

0.0: My files tell me that you've reached #bLv. 70#k as Luminous. I've carefully and thoughtfully put together some equipment that will help you out. Would you like to accept the equipment box now?

no.0: I'll keep the box here for you until you get to Lv. 79, then. After that, it's getting recycled, so don't wait too long.

yes.0: I've placed the box in your Use inventory. Now, excuse me while I laminate my color pencil boxes.
